name: Lead Generation Shell - Capture, Score, Route

parameters.content:
## Lead Generation Shell
Replace each placeholder (NoOp) node below with real nodes as you build this out:

1. Enrich Lead Data -> a Clearbit / Apollo / HTTP Request node to pull extra info on the lead
2. Score Lead -> a Set / Code / IF node that scores or qualifies the lead
3. Route Lead -> a CRM node (HubSpot/Pipedrive), Slack, or Email node to notify sales or create a record

The Webhook Trigger is inactive by default so it's safe to import and edit.

nodes.name: 1. Enrich Lead Data
nodes.notes: Replace with a node that enriches the incoming lead (company size, role, etc.) via an API like Clearbit or Apollo.

nodes.name: 2. Score Lead
nodes.notes: Replace with a Set/Code/IF node that applies scoring rules and decides if the lead qualifies.

nodes.name: 3. Route Lead
nodes.notes: Replace with the node that sends the lead onward: CRM record, Slack alert to sales, or a follow-up email.
